description: This file defines a Java class 'KeycloakProperties' that manages configuration properties and provides a singleton instance for interacting with Keycloak, an identity and access management service. It pulls configuration values from application properties and constructs a Keycloak client instance.

classes.name: KeycloakProperties
classes.description: A Spring component that manages Keycloak configuration properties and provides a singleton Keycloak client instance.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the Keycloak client, initializing it if necessary based on configuration properties.

methods.name: getRealm
methods.description: Returns the realm name loaded from configuration properties.
